description: Trigger a full or partial render export for one or all scenes, applying all project skills.

inputs.scope: string — 'all' for full spot, or a scene ID for a single scene

expected_output.description: Structured render specification for the requested scope and format

steps.purpose: Get scene list, durations, asset refs, and audio sync points for the requested scope
Resolve all asset paths and check for stale flags

steps.condition: if any asset or scene in scope has stale: true
steps.message: The following assets or scenes are marked stale: [list]. Proceed with stale assets, or refresh first?
steps.purpose: Prevent rendering from stale inputs without human awareness
Execute the standard scene render flow for each scene in scope
Verify output constraints (runtime ≤ 30.5s, logo appears in last 4s, product by t=12s)

steps.condition: if any constraint in overview.md is violated
steps.message: Constraint violation detected: [describe]. Cannot emit render spec. Please resolve before exporting.
steps.purpose: Stop before producing a non-compliant render
Return the full render specification for the pipeline
